title: Organ-specific Glucose Uptake Measurement in Mice
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x4cfqsw

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5-6 days prior to the experiment.

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast the mice either overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours before starting the experiment.

steps.title: Restrain Mouse
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer and tape-tether its tail at one end.

steps.title: Administer 2-deoxy-D-[1-14C] glucose
steps.instruction: Administer 10 μCi of 2-deoxy-D-[1-14C] glucose (2-[14C]DG) to awake mice.

substeps.instruction: Perform an intravenous bolus injection, or alternatively, an intraperitoneal injection.

steps.title: Freeze-Clamp and Store Tissues
steps.instruction: After 30 minutes, rapidly freeze-clamp the tissues in liquid N2 and store samples in a -80ºC freezer for biochemical assay.

steps.title: Prepare Biochemical Assay Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up the necessary equipment and columns for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a heat block set to ~100°C.
Wash anion-exchange columns with 5 ml of dH2O.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Process 50–100 mg of frozen tissue samples (e.g., skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, heart).

substeps.instruction: Add ten times the volume of dH2O (e.g., 500 µl dH2O for 50 mg of tissue) in glass tubes and homogenize using a tissue homogenizer.
Place glass tubes in the 100°C heat block for 10 min.

steps.title: Clarify Homogenate
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the tissue debris.

substeps.instruction: Transfer homogenized samples to microcentrifuge tubes using transfer pipettes.

steps.title: Measure Total 14C
steps.instruction: Determine the total 14C levels in the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 33 µl of homogenate (supernatant) to 467 µl dH2O in a scintillation vial labeled 'total'.
Add 5 ml of scintillation cocktail and vortex.
Count the sample for 14C using a liquid scintillation counter.

steps.title: Separate 2-[14C]DG-6-P from 2-[14C]DG
steps.instruction: Use anion-exchange columns to isolate the phosphorylated glucose.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 333 µl of homogenate (supernatant) to the anion-exchange columns.
Wash the columns with 2 ml of dH2O three times, collecting the output into a vial labeled 'wash'.
Vortex the 'wash' samples and transfer 500 µl to another set of scintillation vials.
Count the 'wash' samples for 14C using a liquid scintillation counter to measure 2-[14C]DG.
Elute the columns with 2 ml of 0.2 M formic acid/0.5 M ammonium acetate three times, collecting the output into a vial labeled 'eluate'.
Vortex the 'eluate' samples and transfer 500 µl to another set of scintillation vials.
Count the 'eluate' samples for 14C using a liquid scintillation counter to measure 2-[14C]DG-6-P.
